LogEntries.Entry: Raiders cleaned out a homesteader's place and took everything to the <Alias=DungeonLocation>. She says they can keep most of it. She wants her bag back.
The raider leading them at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> had the homesteader's bag. I took it back. She's waiting at the <Alias=FinalLocation>.
I've got the Goods Package. It goes to <Alias=FinalLocation> on <Alias=targetPlanet>, whenever I'm heading that way.
Raiders took a homesteader's things to the <Alias=DungeonLocation>. I went in after them, got her bag back and returned it. She said they could keep the credits.

Objectives.DisplayText: Recover the stolen belongings from the <Alias=DungeonLocation>
Return the bag to the homesteader at the <Alias=FinalLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You've got that look. Did you actually go in there?
They took my credits as well, and I don't care. You can't buy back what's in here.
Anything that wasn't bolted down. Stuff comes back.
Nothing anyone would steal on purpose.
Old photos, a hat, and a book I've read nine times. They took it because it was there.
Anything that'll put up with me.
Beans, mostly. Beans are very forgiving.
Oh. Hello. Sorry, I'm a bit on edge today.
I don't care about most of it. There's a bag, though.
If anyone's going in there, I'd like the bag back.
